what: qe-ABC-298-freeze: SG2's hand cases (ADR-0077 d6, SG2 (a) and (c)), written from ADR-0077's words alone, with no patch in the world and none read. Every expected answer was worked by hand, then checked against main's own oracle (sg2-oracle.mjs, sg2c.ref.ts).

conventions.piece: PAWN 1, KNIGHT 2, BISHOP 3, ROOK 4, QUEEN 5, KING 6; black adds 8; EMPTY 0
conventions.bits: the move bits a table slot holds: packMove = from | to << 7 | promotion << 14 (src/transposition.ts). A case gives from, to, promotion; bits is that word
conventions.oracle: entryMove(slot, legalMoves(position)) on main (ADR-0077 d2): null when no legal move packs to the bits, else the listed Move. 'expect' is null or the twin's six fields [from, to, piece, captured, flags, promotion]
conventions.parse: a case marked grammarOnly is built with parseFenGrammarOnly (src/fen.ts): parseFen refuses a castling right the board contradicts (A06), so such a board reaches the check only that way; every other case uses parseFen
conventions.every case: the check returns the oracle's answer, field-equal, and the position is byte-identical after the call: toFen and zobristKey equal to before (SG2 (a))

sg2a_per_square_row.what: the per-square generator's oracle row (ADR-0077 d2, d6 SG2 (a)): for a position and a square, the new src/moves.ts export returns exactly generateMoves(position).filter((m) => m.from === square)
sg2a_per_square_row.expect: deep-equal, in the same order, field for field, for every on-board square (castles included for a king on its home square, as generateMoves appends them) and for every off-board 0x88 square (an empty list); the position byte-identical (toFen, zobristKey) after each call
sg2a_per_square_row.positions: every FEN of sg2a above, the six perft roots of src/perft.test.ts, and the G4 corpus (raw/out/g4-0-corpus.jsonl, 301 FENs)

sg2c.what: never played (ADR-0077 d6 SG2 (c)): a search whose table holds an illegal or stale move at a node of remaining depth 1 or 2 that it reaches never makes that move, and returns a legal move with the position restored

node.why: black to move; the knight on e7 is pinned to Ke8 by Re1 along the e-file

seeds.what: an illegal hash move: Ne7-c6, the pinned knight leaving its line (pseudo-legal, illegal)
a stale hash move: a2-a4, the bits of a legal move of the parent position (its from-square is empty here)

sg2c.how_the_table_holds_it: vi.mock('./transposition.ts') calling through: after every clearTable, storeEntry(nodeKey, 0, BOUND_LOWER, 0, 0, seed) puts the seed in the node's slot (stored depth 0, so tableCutoff, which cuts only at the exact depth, never cuts on it); and every storeEntry for nodeKey writes the seed's bits in place of the move it was given (depth, bound and score unchanged), so every later visit reads the seed too
sg2c.precondition: the case is not vacuous: during the search, probeTable(nodeKey) hit at least once and the tableCutoff call that followed it ran at remaining depth 1 or 2 (S4: both) and returned null. On main this holds for every seed and search (sg2c.ref.ts)
expect: no makeMove call is made with the seed's from and to (and promotion) on the node (position key equal to nodeKey before the call): a vi.mock('./apply.ts') spy calling through
the result's move is field-equal to a move of legalMoves(root)
toFen(root) and zobristKey(root) equal their values before the call
on main the result (move, score, nodes) is main's for that seeded search; INFO, not a bar
